profile.reading: This Expedient facility, named Tidepoint, is located at 1050 Hull Street, Suite 150, Baltimore, Maryland 21230. The operator own facility page describes 23,000 square feet of data center space, including 8,900 square feet of raised floor, a critical IT load of 1.5 MW, and 3.6 MW of total generator capacity, on a 2N UPS configuration. The facility connects to 4 on net carriers. The page states SOC 1, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and HITRUST compliance. This facility, Tidepoint, is one of two buildings Expedient groups under its Baltimore market, alongside the separate BWI1 facility in Owings Mills tracked elsewhere in this registry; both share one operator regional page but carry distinct addresses, critical IT loads, and specifications rather than being treated as a single undifferentiated campus. Expedient traces to the October 2003 acquisition of Stargate Business, a Pittsburgh-based company, after which Expedient formally designated Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania as its headquarters in May 2004, citing Stargate's established infrastructure and the roughly 70 percent of Expedient's workforce already based there; the company was at that time privately owned within the Continental Broadband family under Landmark Communications, and its ownership has since changed to AMP Capital, an Australian investment firm, as its investment sponsor. Downtown Baltimore's Tidepoint area has developed as a modest interconnection point for the region, distinct from the denser Northern Virginia cluster tracked extensively elsewhere in this registry. No year-opened date specific to this facility was located in sourcing reachable this session. No further public ownership or tenant-mix detail specific to this building was located this session. This registry treats the OSM-mapped coordinates and the operator-published Suite 150 address as referring to the same facility absent evidence otherwise.
profile.capacity_note: Operator also states 3.6 MW of total generator capacity, a backup power figure distinct from the 1.5 MW critical IT load recorded here.

reading.body:
Expedient Tidepoint is a 1.5 MW critical IT load facility in Baltimore city, Maryland, ranked second among the three facilities in the state with published power specifications. At typical AI training density of 40 kW per rack, 1.5 MW of IT load translates to roughly 37 racks, an assumption that reflects current hyperscaler practice but is not stated by the operator. The facility occupies 23,000 square feet total with 8,900 square feet of raised floor, and connects to 4 on-net carriers.

The facility holds SOC 1, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and HITRUST certifications, qualifying it to host regulated workloads in healthcare and payment processing. These certifications do not indicate which tenants actually occupy the space or whether any are AI workloads. The operator also publishes 3.6 MW of total generator capacity, a backup power figure distinct from the 1.5 MW critical IT load, indicating the site is not power-constrained for outages but is sized for its stated active load.

Tidepoint accounts for 16 percent of Maryland's 9.3 MW of published data center capacity across three facilities. The state has 11 mapped data center locations, but most publish no capacity figure, so the true active capacity and rank of this facility relative to all sites in Maryland are not known from published specifications. The site's relevance to AI scaling depends on whether its current 1.5 MW load is expandable, a figure the operator has not published.
